world_org_meetings.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
world_org_meetings.description: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

world_org_meetings.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.

world_org_meetings.title: EU diplomats object to G20 photo with Lavrov, prompting US cancellation
world_org_meetings.description: The meeting in Atlanta will go ahead as planned, ahead of a G20 leaders’ summit hosted by President Donald Trump at his Miami golf club in December.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
world_org_meetings.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Russia's presence divides G20 ministers
world_org_meetings.description: The G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in the US is wrapping up two days of talks without agreement on several key global security issues. On the sidelines, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio signed an Arctic cooperation deal with Japan and South Korea and confirmed Washington’s participation in Riyadh’s World Expo in 2030. Meanwhile, European ministers confronted Russia’s Sergei Lavrov over the war in Ukraine and refused to join him for the traditional group photo. Jack Pownall reports.

diplomatic_visits.title: Melania Trump hosted officials from Russia and Ukraine. Just what's behind her peace push?
diplomatic_visits.description: As President Donald Trump and his fellow Republicans take stock after a devastating midterm election that saw the Democrats seize control of Congress, his wife Melania is preparing to host representatives who will almost certainly praise Washington's actions.

diplomatic_visits.title: Spain: Zelensky urges Latin America to help repair Ukraine's power grid
diplomatic_visits.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has appealed to Spain and Latin American countries for urgent help repairing Ukraine's damaged energy infrastructure. He also met King Felipe VI during the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid.

diplomatic_visits.title: Milei and Sánchez exchange a cold greeting at Ibero-American Summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Argentine President Javier Milei and Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez exchanged a brief and frosty greeting at the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Wednesday. Their encounter comes two weeks after Milei called Sánchez an “unpresentable dictator”.

diplomatic_visits.title: US First Lady Melania Trump to host Ukrainian and Russian officials at White House
diplomatic_visits.description: On Wednesday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded the first lady a national honour for her role in brokering a partial ceasefire that allowed the evacuation of civilians from a Russian-occupied town.

diplomatic_visits.title: Jimmy Kimmel roasts Trump in late night monologue amid 'blue tsunami' midterms
diplomatic_visits.description: Late night host Jimmy Kimmel had some choice words for U.S. President Donald Trump last night as a “blue tsunami” stormed the country during the U.S. elections, quipping in the monologue of ABC's Jimmy Kimmel Live! that Trump was "already running out of dipping sauce containers to throw at the television set."

elections.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
elections.description: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Mark Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.

elections.title: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
elections.description: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

elections.title: Ohio and Texas went from red to blue in the midterms but may not stay that way in 2028
elections.description: The Democrats flipping governorships and Senate seats in Texas and Ohio turned the states dramatically blue on election night. Some political observers say these wins don't necessarily mean the states will stay that colour, but they do reveal a new political reality — that they'll be electoral battlegrounds in the 2028 presidential election.

elections.title: Small eastern Caribbean archipelago seeking slavery reparations holds general election
elections.description: Grenada and other eastern Caribbean islands are voting in general elections

elections.title: Arrests and investigations as Serbia begins post-election clean-up
elections.description: The landslide victory of the Students' List in Serbia's general election seems to have removed a blockage in the justice system: Cases that were long stalled are now suddenly moving forward.
